name: AF blue tie, four-in-hand (plain blue herringbone twill)
size_basis: Same visible shape as the blazer base tie; plain blue (the regulation: blue polyester or silk, herringbone twill; no pattern). Blue shade is an estimate. The tip must cover part of the belt buckle but not extend below it (4.2.5.1.4); the tie is shown cropped like the blazer base.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: AF blue tie authorized with the corporate service dress (4.2.3.4); the aviator shirt uniform requires a blue tie (the CAP regimental tie is not authorized there, 4.2.5.1.4)
tie tack or clasp centred between the bottom of the knot and the tip (4.2.3.4, 4.2.5.1.4): `tie_tack_center`
